title: Ancient Spartan doctor's treatise describing PTSD

tellings.quote: but we have archaeological evidence that goes all the way back to the Spartans. >> And there was a doctor that had written a treatise back then.

plain: Combat trauma of the kind now called PTSD was recognised as far back as ancient Sparta, where a doctor wrote a treatise about it, according to Greg Rogers, a NASA doctor, who tells Michels there is archaeological evidence reaching back to the Spartans. He gives no title or name for the treatise, and offers it to show how long people have known that terrible experiences leave lasting marks on the mind.
